svg.title: SQL Database in Fabric: From OLTP Write to Analytics Endpoint Visibility
svg.desc: An internals diagram. A client authenticates via Entra ID (the only supported method) and writes to the primary compute node of the Hyperscale-architected transactional engine, which is durable and strongly consistent immediately. Independently, Fabric continuously replicates that data into OneLake, converting it to Delta Parquet, which powers a read-only SQL analytics endpoint with eventual, near-real-time consistency. The analytics endpoint can federate across other Fabric items using three-part naming with no data movement. A warning node calls out the resulting consistency gap: a query against the analytics endpoint immediately after a write can return stale data, and it must not be relied on for read-your-writes correctness.
svg.text: SQL Database in Fabric — Replication Path Internals

Fabric Atlas — original diagram, July 2026. Not a Microsoft asset.

g.title: Entra ID authentication gate — Every connection authenticates via Microsoft Entra ID; SQL authentication is not supported.

g.aria-label: Hyperscale primary compute: durable OLTP write
g.title: Hyperscale primary compute: durable OLTP write — Write lands on the single primary compute node; storage and compute scale independently.

g.aria-label: Continuous replication to OneLake as Parquet/Delta
g.title: Continuous replication to OneLake as Parquet/Delta — Fabric automatically and continuously replicates data into OneLake in near-real time, converted to Parquet.
SQL analytics endpoint (read-only) — Auto-provisioned, read-only analytical access to the replicated OneLake data — isolated from OLTP write traffic.
Cross-item federated queries — Three-part T-SQL naming joins other Fabric items (warehouses, mirrored DBs, SQL databases) with no data movement.

g.aria-label: Warning: eventual consistency on the analytics endpoint
g.title: Warning: eventual consistency on the analytics endpoint — A write just committed is not guaranteed visible on the analytics endpoint immediately — no read-your-writes guarantee.
